title: Chord Sobolev inequalities
summary: The paper establishes a new family of sharp analytic inequalities. Together with the fractional Sobolev inequalities of Almgren and Lieb, they form a complete class of analytic inequalities, referred to as the chord Sobolev inequalities. A close connection between these inequalities and chord isoperimetric inequalities in integral geometry is established through a functional extension of chord power integrals. The limiting cases of the chord Sobolev inequalities are derived, one of which yields a logarithmic Sobolev-type inequality. Combined with the work of Bourgain, Brezis, and Mironescu,…
